title: The Air You Cannot See in a Classroom
title_ja: 教室の見えない空気を考える

source_links.title: CDC: Ventilation in Schools and Childcare Programs

fact_notes: 背景となる考え方は添付の資料で確認。本文と練習問題は新規制作。例示した人物・学校・活動は架空の説明用設定。

sentences.en: Students notice that their classroom feels crowded and uncomfortable during a long afternoon lesson.
sentences.ja: 生徒たちは午後の長い授業で教室が混み合い不快だと感じます。

sentences.en: A teacher suggests thinking about the movement of air rather than assuming that opening one window always solves the problem.
sentences.ja: 教師は窓一つを開ければ必ず解決すると思わず、空気の動きを考えるよう提案します。

sentences.en: However, air quality cannot be judged reliably by whether a room feels cool or warm.
sentences.ja: しかし空気の質は部屋が涼しいか暖かいかだけでは確実に判断できません。

sentences.en: Small particles released when people breathe or speak may remain in the air under some conditions.
sentences.ja: 人が呼吸や会話をすると放出される小さな粒子は、条件によって空気中に残ることがあります。

sentences.en: CDC guidance describes ventilation as one of several ways to reduce the risk of spreading infections in schools.
sentences.ja: CDCの指針は換気を学校で感染症の拡大リスクを減らす複数の方法の一つと説明します。

sentences.en: Keeping a learning space healthy requires attention to air movement as well as other preventive measures.
sentences.ja: 学習空間を健康的に保つには空気の動きと他の予防策の両方への配慮が必要です。

sentences.en: A school maintenance team checks whether the existing ventilation equipment is working as intended.
sentences.ja: 学校の維持管理チームは既存の換気設備が意図どおり動くか確認します。

sentences.en: For example, they examine whether fresh outdoor air can safely enter and whether filters are correctly installed.
sentences.ja: 例えば安全に外気を取り込めるか、フィルターが適切に設置されているかを調べます。

sentences.en: Opening windows may help in some situations, but weather, noise, or outdoor pollution can make this approach unsuitable.
sentences.ja: 窓を開けることが役立つ場合もありますが、天候、騒音、屋外の汚染で不適切な場合もあります。

sentences.en: A device that moves air around a room is not automatically the same as a system that brings in outdoor air.
sentences.ja: 部屋の空気を循環させる装置は外気を取り込む仕組みと必ずしも同じではありません。

sentences.en: Teachers should therefore seek qualified advice rather than make technical changes that could create other safety concerns.
sentences.ja: 教師は別の安全問題を生むかもしれない技術変更を自分で行うのでなく、適切な助言を求めるべきです。

sentences.en: The aim is to improve the conditions of the room without introducing new risks.
sentences.ja: 目標は新しい危険を生まずに教室の条件を改善することです。

sentences.en: The students prepare a project comparing different ways schools can support cleaner indoor air.
sentences.ja: 生徒は学校で室内の空気をよりきれいにする方法を比較する活動を準備します。

sentences.en: In addition, they consider the cost of equipment, energy use, noise, and the needs of students who are sensitive to cold.
sentences.ja: さらに設備費、エネルギー使用、騒音、寒さに敏感な生徒の必要を考えます。

sentences.en: A plan that improves one feature may make another aspect of the classroom less comfortable.
sentences.ja: 一つの面を改善する計画が別の面で教室を不快にするかもしれません。

sentences.en: The group recognizes that a simple measurement does not reveal every cause of poor air quality.
sentences.ja: グループは簡単な測定では空気の悪さのすべての原因がわからないと認識します。

sentences.en: Professional checks and reliable guidance are necessary before changing building systems or claiming a medical benefit.
sentences.ja: 建物設備を変えたり医学的利益を主張したりする前に専門的な確認と信頼できる指針が必要です。

sentences.en: An effective solution must balance health, accessibility, energy, and everyday classroom use.
sentences.ja: 効果的な解決には健康、利用しやすさ、エネルギー、日常授業を両立させる必要があります。

sentences.en: The school eventually explains its ventilation plan in language that students and families can understand.
sentences.ja: 学校は最終的に生徒や家庭が理解できる言葉で換気計画を説明します。

sentences.en: It describes which changes are being considered, what experts have checked, and what remains uncertain.
sentences.ja: 検討する変更、専門家の確認内容、不確かな点を説明します。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the plan does not promise that ventilation alone will prevent every infection.
sentences.ja: それでも換気だけですべての感染症を防げるとは約束しません。

sentences.en: Students learn that responsible health communication avoids guarantees that the evidence cannot support.
sentences.ja: 生徒は責任ある健康情報では証拠が支えられない保証を避けると学びます。

sentences.en: They also understand that a healthy classroom depends on many actions working together, not one impressive machine.
sentences.ja: 健康的な教室は一台の印象的な機械でなく複数の対策の組み合わせにかかると理解します。

sentences.en: The best school environment is designed with practical conditions, clear information, and the needs of learners in mind.
sentences.ja: 最良の学校環境は実際の条件、明確な情報、学習者の必要を考えて設計されます。

questions.prompt: What is the passage primarily about?
options: School air quality requires practical ventilation planning and realistic health communication.
Opening one window always prevents all infections.
All classrooms need exactly the same equipment.
Air quality can be judged only by temperature.
questions.explanation_ja: 換気と現実的な健康情報の両立が主題です。

questions.prompt: What does CDC describe ventilation as?
options: A replacement for all preventive measures.
One part of reducing infection risks in schools.
questions.explanation_ja: 感染リスクを減らす一つの対策です。

questions.prompt: Why can't comfort alone measure air quality?
options: Feeling warm or cool does not reveal every airborne risk.
All rooms have identical air movement.
questions.explanation_ja: 体感温度だけでは危険を測れません。

questions.prompt: What does the maintenance team check?
options: Outdoor air intake and correct filter installation.
questions.explanation_ja: 外気とフィルターを確認します。

questions.prompt: What can make opening windows unsuitable?
questions.explanation_ja: 天候や騒音などの制約があります。

questions.prompt: Why should teachers seek expert advice before changing systems?
options: Every teacher is a trained engineer.
Technical changes may create other safety problems.
questions.explanation_ja: 不適切な変更で別の危険が生じ得るからです。
balanceは複数の条件を両立させることです。

questions.prompt: What factors do students consider besides health?
options: Only the size of the school gate.
Energy use, cost, noise, and different learners' needs.
questions.explanation_ja: エネルギー、費用、騒音、個人差です。

questions.prompt: Why does the plan avoid promising perfect prevention?
options: Ventilation is only one measure and evidence does not justify a guarantee.
questions.explanation_ja: 換気だけで完全防止とはいえないからです。

options: Every school must buy one specific product.
Healthy environments should be based on evidence, practical conditions, and learners' needs.
Students should never ask about the air.
questions.explanation_ja: 根拠と実情を考える結論です。

grammar.explanation_ja: not automaticallyによる限定と関係代名詞thatを含みます。

grammar.explanation_ja: does not everyはすべてを意味しない部分否定です。
notは対比による強調です。
